premises.text: The world is largely powered by fossil fuels, with minimal progress towards green energy.
premises.evidence_span: 84% of the world is powered by fossil fuels. That's only a 2% decrease in the past 20 years.

premises.text: Current battery technologies use toxic and scarce metals.
premises.evidence_span: the metals that we use in our current battery tech are not only toxic, but very scarce as well.

premises.text: Recycling initiatives are insufficient for addressing battery material issues.
premises.evidence_span: recycling initiatives, while they're very noble, are nothing but a short-term Band-Aid solution.

premises.text: A transition to greener batteries is necessary for a sustainable future.
premises.evidence_span: a dream of a greener future demands greener batteries.

premises.text: Flint's paper batteries are rechargeable and made from hydrogen-reinforced cellulose paper.
premises.evidence_span: we have invented what we call hydrogen-reinforced cellulose paper and utilized zinc and manganese as the two sides of the battery.

premises.text: Flint's batteries are fully compostable and reduce environmental impact.
premises.evidence_span: our batteries are fully compostable, which means at the end of its lifecycle, you can throw it into the ground, and within a month, it would completely degrade.

premises.text: The design of Flint's batteries allows them to be bent and cut while operational without safety hazards.
premises.evidence_span: our batteries can be bent while operational without affecting its performance or causing any kind of safety hazard.

premises.text: Flint's batteries can be produced using existing manufacturing processes.
premises.evidence_span: we didn't have to reinvent the wheel to create this. We used existing manufacturing processes and equipment.

premises.text: The cost of Flint's paper batteries is significantly lower than traditional batteries.
premises.evidence_span: the cost of making our paper batteries isn't two times or three times cheaper, but it's ten times cheaper.

premises.text: Flint's batteries can match or outperform lithium batteries in specific applications.
premises.evidence_span: we decided to come up with three versions of specialized paper batteries for a focused area of application, so that we can either match or outperform lithium batteries in these areas.

value.text: Flint's paper batteries provide a safer, more sustainable, and cost-effective alternative to traditional batteries.
value.evidence_span: safer, more sustainable, and cost-efficient future in battery tech.
